styles.a: Bright flat storybook fantasy illustration, clean shapes, soft light, cheerful saturated colours, friendly and inviting, no blood, no gore, no scary faces, no text, no letters, no numbers.
styles.sprite: Bright flat storybook fantasy game sprite high-angle three-quarter top-down view, camera far above and slightly in front, looking down on the character, big head, tiny foreshortened legs, character looking up at the camera, chunky rounded friendly shapes, thin dark outline, soft shading, cheerful colours, cute not scary, no blood, no gore, no text, no letters.
styles.icon: Bright flat storybook fantasy game icon, one bold object centred on a soft plain pale background, thick friendly shapes, thin dark outline, glowing magical light, cheerful colours, no text, no letters, no numbers.
styles.portrait: Bright flat storybook fantasy character portrait, head and shoulders, front view, friendly smile, thin dark outline, soft light, plain soft coloured background, cheerful colours, no blood, no text, no letters.
styles.ground: Flat top-down tiling ground texture for a children's fantasy game, calm soft colours with low contrast so small things on top stand out, even all over, no big features, no shadows from the side, no text.

pictures.name: card
pictures.prompt: Wide storybook landscape, calm pale dusk sky across the top with a few soft clouds, a tiny castle far behind on a hill. In the middle of a green castle field a small friendly knight in silver armour and a blue cape stands ready, with three glowing silver swords spinning in a bright golden ring around the knight. From every edge of the picture a crowd of small cute green goblins with pointy ears and little wooden clubs, round bouncy green slimes and small purple bats come marching in towards the knight. Wide landscape picture for a game title card, the knight small and clear in the middle. Suitable for children aged 8 to 11.
